tileParams.description: A storm-race between beacons while the Claim-Boat remains under attack; the fastest water runs nearest the front. Engine dependency: checkpoint racing and competing-racer loot still need a consumer.

objectives.description: Sail the full beacon course before the corsair racers loot its checkpoints.
Keep the Claim-Boat intact while racing.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches storm-reading as a skill the player can feel improving by rewarding daring lines near the weather front.

engineDependencies.description: Needs a checkpoint race and competing-racer loot consumer; storm scheduling and Claim-Boat movement already exist.

briefing.geographyLine: An open-water beacon course bends north toward the fast storm-front water before returning to the finish.
